site.title: Ananya & Arjun — Wedding
site.description: Walk through the Dakshineswar temple complex to our wedding — the date, events, travel and RSVP.

gate.body: Together with their families, {names} request the honour of your presence as they are joined in marriage at Dakshineswar.

ceremony.title: The wedding ceremony
ceremony.body: Bor jatri arrives at 6. Shubho drishti — the first look — around 8, then the saat paak, the seven rounds around the fire.
ceremony.dress: Traditional — saris, panjabis, lots of colour

story.heading: Our story
story.intro: A few of the moments that brought us here.

timeline.title: First hello
timeline.text: A shared umbrella outside College Street, and a cup of cha that went cold because nobody stopped talking.

timeline.title: The long walk
timeline.text: From Prinsep Ghat to Millennium Park and back, twice, because neither wanted to say goodnight.

timeline.title: Two cities, one calendar
timeline.text: Bangalore and Kolkata, weekend flights, and a shared spreadsheet of every trip.

timeline.title: Yes
timeline.text: On the terrace, under a very wet sky, with a ring that had been hiding in a sock drawer for three months.

events.heading: Events
events.intro: Three days of celebration in the courtyard and by the river. Come to all, or to whichever you can.

list.name: Aiburo Bhaat
list.note: A last unmarried feast — lots of food, lots of teasing.

list.name: Gaye Holud
list.note: Turmeric, laughter and a fair amount of getting messy.

list.name: Sangeet
list.note: Dance floor opens at 8. No excuses.

list.name: Wedding Ceremony
list.note: Bor jatri arrives at 6. Shubho drishti around 8.

list.name: Reception
list.note: Dinner, speeches, and one more dance.

travel.heading: Travel & stay
travel.intro: Everything you need to get here and rest well.

gettingThere.title: By air
gettingThere.text: Fly into Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU). The venue is about 45 minutes by cab.

gettingThere.title: By train
gettingThere.text: Howrah and Sealdah are both around 30 minutes away. Pre-paid taxis are available at the station.

gettingThere.title: Getting around
gettingThere.text: Uber and Ola work well. Yellow taxis are charming but negotiate the fare first.

hotels.name: The Placeholder Grand
hotels.text: Closest to the venue, 5 minutes. Mention the wedding for a group rate.

hotels.name: Hotel Ganga View
hotels.text: Mid-range, by the river, 15 minutes away.

hotels.name: Guest house at the venue
hotels.text: Limited rooms for family. Ask us if you need one.

rsvp.heading: RSVP
rsvp.intro: Please let us know by 15 January 2027.

footer.line: Made with love, terracotta and a little bit of JavaScript.
